g.text: Region, RNA-QC, weighting and counting-definition sensitivity
Equal = mean barcode CPM, then log2(mean CPM + 1). RNA is reused across region/count definitions, not replicated.
Grouping counts each coordinate/barcode group once in both locus numerator and total-depth denominator.
Neither count definition certifies physical molecules. All 128 paired cases and 64 grouping deltas are retained.
